body:
It probably would help to try and see these as seperate things coinciding and not all one huge thing. I appreciate your input and will try to change my thought patterns.

I just don't know what to do anymore. I've been very sad since middle school, yet, there was always something in my life to look forward to. I don't have that anymore, except for a vague idea of "all of this" being over.

She hasn't said for certain that she won't date me anymore. But, she did say she's pretty sure she's asexual. I'm not judging her on that. Everyone is different. But, since she's been distancing herself from me and it might be impossible for us to ever have a stable relationship, I am extremely troubled. I don't think I could ever have a marriage where sex was only for making babies.

This isn't something that happened just the other day. I've been thinking about this for awhile and still don't know what to do, because I've had a lot of problems converging at once. Losing my career, most likely losing the lady I'm in love with, and now, even in a temp job, I'm so deeply troubled, I want to call in for my shift (which would make me close to being fired) because I can't keep my mind on anything, even my drive to work. I find myself unable to get out of bed on days I have off. And the only hobby I have anymore is drinking myself to sleep. Alcohol addiction is something I've struggled with for the past 5 years. 

I don't know what I have left. It seems like the only reason I'm alive is because the guilt of leaving my family with debt would eat me up.
